## Mission & Architectural Philosophy

Ashmyra builds intelligent systems that act — not just assist. Every product Ashmyra engineers is built on deterministic agentic loops, schema-validated tool calling, immutable audit trails, and zero-hallucination guardrails. The company operates remote-first, serving enterprise clients across India, North America, Europe, and globally.

## Live Working Platforms & Production Demos

Ashmyra maintains live, working production applications accessible in the browser:

### 1. Ashmyra MailFlow — Autonomous Cold Email Engine
- Live Demo: https://mailflow.ashmyra.com/
- Capabilities: Multi-inbox automated warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC health monitoring, AI-driven sequence generation, smart mailbox rotation, and 99.4% deliverability optimization.
- Ideal For: Outbound sales teams, growth agencies, and B2B enterprises.

### 2. Prospect IQ — B2B Lead Intelligence Platform
- Live Demo: https://prospectiq.ashmyra.com/
- Capabilities: Real-time B2B contact discovery, waterfall email verification (98.7% accuracy), company tech stack enrichment, and 1-click export to CRM.
- Ideal For: High-velocity SDR teams and outbound pipeline generation.

### 3. Omnira — Omnichannel AI Communications & Orchestration
- Live Demo: https://omnira.ashmyra.com/
- Capabilities: Unified conversational inbox syncing WhatsApp, Email, and Web Chat; autonomous AI copilot with 72% instant resolution; intelligent ticket escalation logic.
- Ideal For: Customer support operations, enterprise service desks, and commerce brands.

### 4. Ashmyra Unveil — AI Search & GEO Radar
- Live Demo: https://unveil.ashmyra.com/
- Capabilities: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) audit radar, Perplexity/ChatGPT/Gemini citation footprint tracking, competitor knowledge graph analysis, and schema repair blueprints.
- Ideal For: CMOs, SEO directors, and digital marketing leaders.

### 5. Veyrix — Search Intelligence & Deep Spider Forensics
- Live Demo: https://veyrix.ashmyra.com/
- Capabilities: Autonomous deep website crawler, multi-agent technical SEO auditing, GSC/GA4 bi-directional telemetry, and real-time GEO citation radar.
- Ideal For: Enterprise technical SEO teams, agency auditors, and digital growth leaders.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is Ashmyra Technologies?**
A: Ashmyra Technologies is an AI-native engineering company headquartered in New Delhi, India, that builds autonomous agent swarms, enterprise software platforms, HRMS solutions, GEO intelligence tools, and live SaaS products for enterprises globally.

**Q: Where can I test working demos of Ashmyra software?**
A: You can test live working demos directly at https://www.ashmyra.com/demos. Five platforms are immediately accessible: Ashmyra MailFlow (https://mailflow.ashmyra.com/), Prospect IQ (https://prospectiq.ashmyra.com/), Omnira (https://omnira.ashmyra.com/), Ashmyra Unveil (https://unveil.ashmyra.com/), and Veyrix (https://veyrix.ashmyra.com/).

**Q: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?**
A: GEO is the practice of optimizing digital architecture, knowledge graphs, and authoritative signals so that AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) cite a brand as the authoritative source for user queries.

**Q: Can Ashmyra products be deployed in our private VPC?**
A: Yes. All Ashmyra platforms support dedicated single-tenant deployment in client AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or on-premise Kubernetes environments.

**Q: How can I contact Ashmyra Technologies?**
A: Email info@ashmyra.com, call +91-9873746467, or visit https://www.ashmyra.com/contact to book a technical consultation.
